content.text: Event Dates Apr 3, 2027 - Apr 11, 2027 Country Prices Starting at Overview View Pricing Signature Packages FAQs Accommodations Masters Week in Augusta, GA The Masters is golf’s first major and the ultimate bucket list experience for any golf fan. Each April, the very best golfers in the world descend on Augusta, Georgia, to compete for the most coveted prize in golf: the green jacket. We offer a variety of packages that will help you check this event off of your bucket list. When is Masters Week? The Masters is typically scheduled for the first full week of April, so that the final round is played on the second Sunday of the month. Below are the dates for the upcoming Masters. Masters 2027 Dates: Women’s Amateur – April 3, 2027 Drive, Chip, and Putt – April 4, 2027 Masters Practice Rounds – April 5-7, 2027 Masters Tournament Rounds – April 8-11, 2027 MyBucketListEvents, LLC is not in any way sponsored by, affiliated with, or a partner of The Masters Golf Tournament, Augusta National Golf Club, or Augusta National, Inc. and the use of the word “The Masters” is for descriptive and informational purposes only. Masters Week at a Glance Each day during Masters Week offers a little something different. Whether you are looking to attend the famous Par-3 contest, witness the final round drama on Sunday afternoon, or simply walk the course and do some shopping, you can’t go wrong with any day of the week. Saturday: Women’s Amateur. This is typically the most accessible day to walk the course, and with all the excitement of competitive golf.Sunday: Drive, Chip, and Putt competition for junior golfers. Access to Practice Facilities only.Monday: Be there as all of the players arrive. The best shopping day all week.Tuesday: Full day of practice rounds. Everyone is there. Sit on #16 and watch golfers skip their ball onto the green.Wednesday: Practice round plus the famous Par-3 Tournament. The best day for autographs.Thursday: Ceremonial first tee shot by legends of the game. Every shot counts now.Friday: The last chance to see every golfer, as many will miss the cut.Saturday: Known as “moving day” as the players jockey to be in the final pairing.Sunday: Championship Sunday complete with a Green Jacket ceremony to finish. Experience Masters Week With Us Bucket List Events has been hosting clients in Augusta for over 20 years! Build your own Masters experience starting with our Masters Week Packages. We offer conveniently-located hotels and private homes to meet your accommodations needs, as well as daily experiences to complement your time on the course.Ready to check this event off your Bucket List? Get in touch with our team. Daily Packages include the following: Course access Book with Confidence policy included with every package Lodging assistance (view our accommodation options) Dedicated on-site event staff Accessibility -Wheelchairs, power wheelchairs, and electric scooters are permitted on the grounds. MyBucketListEvents, LLC is not in any way sponsored by, affiliated with, or a partner of The Masters Golf Tournament, Augusta National Golf Club, or Augusta National, Inc. and the use of the word “The Masters” is for descriptive and informational purposes only. The Most Famous Course in the World For the patrons who are lucky enough to enter the grounds each year, it is an unforgettable experience. From walking the course and soaking up the views to recounting the many chapters of golf history that have unfolded on these grounds, Bucket List clients make lifelong memories as they watch golf’s best compete for the coveted green jacket. We hope you will join us to add to those memories.
